units.function: Thin host-side wrapper around the shared Zod plugin manifest v1 schema, offering safe and throwing parse modes plus a supported-version list.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends directly on @paperclipai/shared schema/types/version and the server HTTP error factory; all substantive manifest field rules live outside this service.
units.keyDataModels: PaperclipPluginManifestV1, Zod issue path/message pairs, a human-readable aggregate error and numeric API versions.
units.lifecycle: Parses an untrusted value into a v1 manifest or turns schema issues into a 400 error; it does not install, authorize, sign, persist or activate the package.
units.testAssessment: No dedicated focused test targets this validator. Indirect plugin tests do not establish a version compatibility matrix, unknown-field policy, structured error stability, hostile-input limits or semantic package invariants.
units.designRationale: Keep one shared schema authority for server and SDK consumers while standardizing install-time HTTP errors.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a versioned, implementation-neutral Connector package descriptor whose syntactic validation is separate from provenance, compatibility, permission review and installation policy.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the single-schema-authority and safe-result pattern, but emit stable error codes and parameters, independently test supported-version alignment, and layer digest/signature/provenance, path containment, capability-policy and cross-field semantic validators.
units.responsibilityConflict: Shape validation alone does not bind a package or requested capabilities to a company, accountable approver, exact digest, data authorization or evidence record; its English error strings are also unsuitable as an API contract.
